title: 'Emergent abilities' may partly be a mirage of metrics
body: Some abilities of large models appear suddenly at scale on benchmarks, but Schaeffer and colleagues argued in 2023 that sharp jumps often vanish under smoother metrics: exact-match scoring hides gradual improvement. The debate matters because forecasts of capability cliffs drive policy. Both things can be true: progress is smoother than headlines, yet thresholds in usefulness are real.
